audience: localization managers and developers who run translations in Transifex

useCases.title: Find languages that still need translations
useCases.text: List the projects of an organization, then list the resources of one project. Read the translation progress per resource and language.

useCases.title: Review the source strings of a resource
useCases.text: Get one resource with its priority and categories. List its source strings with their keys, context and tags, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Check open translation tasks
useCases.text: List the translation tasks of an organization with their status and due dates. Open one task to see its assignees and completion time.

useCases.title: List the glossaries of an organization
useCases.text: List the glossaries of one organization with their names, slugs and source languages. Check a language code first with the language list.

useCases.title: Create a project for a new app
useCases.text: Create a project in an organization with a name, slug and privacy setting. It adds no translations and deletes nothing.
